description: Redesign the ENTIRE hairstyle on this exact original Shaman FRONT head as ONE coherent haircut. Long dense sweeping bangs COMPLETELY CONCEAL BOTH EYES, with no eyes or eye whites showing. Five broad flowing overlapping locks curve organically from the crown all the way down past the eyes to the upper nose bridge. Crown, mid-length and tips are ONE continuous curved surface with coherent directional lighting. Use broad diagonal tapering clusters, rounded volume close to skull, varied pointed ends. No straight vertical bars, no square eye patches, no horizontal join, no center part revealing eyes, no black band or painted eyes. Muted lavender silver hair with violet shadows, clean intentional pixel clusters and small soft highlights following each entire lock from root toward tip. Ear-length side pieces; nose tip mouth chin and ears stay the same. Hair edit ONLY: unchanged original face lives beneath separate hair. Original compact MMORPG pixel density, native crisp pixels, no antialiasing, no tall spikes, hat or accessories, no torso. Transparent background and complete hair silhouette with empty margins. Preserve all unmasked pixels exactly. One FRONT head only.
